name: OMNIPHI CASINO NETWORK: Dreamfloor Edition
description: OmniPhi's full-immersion neural casino experience layers a procedurally generated luxury resort over the user's physical location, allowing Tier 3 subscribers to gamble in a simulated Spire penthouse while sitting in a Tier 2 apartment. The platform offers neural poker, synthetic horse racing, and proprietary luck-weighting algorithms that subtly favor continued play over exits. Regulators have repeatedly questioned whether the BCI integration constitutes consent manipulation, but OmniPhi's Sable Charter exemptions have kept the platform operating.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 debt counselor discovers their client has been neurally locked into a Dreamfloor session for eleven hours, physically unable to disengage without medical intervention.
A cheating algorithm planted inside the Dreamfloor's luck-weighting system has been quietly redirecting a fraction of every pot to an unknown wallet for three years.
A runner is hired to steal the Dreamfloor's proprietary 'consent architecture' source code and deliver it to a Sable Charter regulatory tribunal.
